jobs.description:
Onwards Together!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

Location:
5 on-site days a week in Sunnyvale, CA Headquarters.

Our Team's Vision

Our Product Management team is driven by a culture that thrives on visionary leadership, autonomy, and ownership, creating a dynamic synergy that drives us forward in the ever-evolving landscape of cybersecurity. We collaborate closely with our Engineering team to tackle real-world challenges our customers face.

Bring your visionary instincts to every stage of the product lifecycle—from conception and definition to development, release, and post-release activities. You'll play a pivotal role in strategic planning, feature selection, and day-to-day tactical operations. Together, our dynamic team propels the roadmap forward as we strive to make the digital world a safer place.

Your Impact

We are seeking an experienced and highly technical Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM)
to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives across our cybersecurity platform. In this role, you will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Security, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, and Support to deliver strategic programs that improve product quality, accelerate releases, and enable customers to adopt our platform with confidence.

You thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving ambiguous problems, and have a proven track record of leading large-scale technical programs from concept through delivery.

Technical Program Leadership

Lead complex, cross-functional programs spanning multiple engineering organizations from planning through successful delivery.
Drive execution of strategic initiatives across cloud, platform, security, infrastructure, and customer-facing product teams.
Establish program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and success metrics.
Develop and maintain reporting to provide regular program status updates.

Product Release Management

Own end-to-end release management for multiple product lines.
Coordinate release readiness activities across Engineering, Product Management, QA, Cloud Operations, Documentation and Customer Support
Drive release planning, Go/No-Go decisions, deployment readiness, and post-release reviews.
Improve release predictability through automation, metrics, and standardized processes.

Cross-functional Execution

Partner with product, engineering and cross functional leaders to identify risks, remove blockers, and drive timely execution.
Coordinate cross-team dependencies across distributed engineering organizations.
Lead technical discussions and facilitate alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities.

Operational Excellence

Define and improve program management best practices across the organization.
Build dashboards, KPIs, executive reporting, and portfolio health metrics.
Develop process improvements, automate workflows and develop tools for PMO efficiencies
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on engineering efficiency, release quality, and operational scalability.

Customer & Strategic Initiatives

Lead strategic customer commitments and Voice of Customer (VoC) initiatives.
Partner with Product and Customer Success to prioritize customer-driven programs.
Coordinate large-scale initiatives involving SaaS migrations, platform modernization, and customer enablement.

Success in This Role

Successful Candidates Will

Deliver complex technical programs on schedule with high quality.
Improve release predictability and execution excellence.
Build trusted partnerships across Product and Engineering.
Anticipate risks before they become issues.
Influence without authority across senior technical leaders.
Create scalable program management processes that improve organizational efficiency.
Drive measurable improvements in delivery, operational excellence, and customer outcomes.

Your Toolkit

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related technical field.
8+ years of Technical Program Management experience in enterprise software, cloud, networking, infrastructure, or cybersecurity.
Experience leading large cross-functional engineering programs across Product, Engineering, QA, Security, Cloud Operations, and Customer Success.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and release management.
Experience managing complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering organizations.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Claude, Copilot or similar tools.
Experience with workflow automation and agent/tools building using AI and/or industry standard tools

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in cybersecurity, cloud, networking, SaaS, or enterprise infrastructure.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, or microservices.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.
Experience driving SaaS releases and cloud deployments.
PMP, Scrum Master, or SAFe certification.

This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

Our Commitment

Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.

If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.

Job Description

Hill International is seeking a Sr. Program Manager in Los Angeles, California

The Sr. Program Manager is responsible for leading complex capital programs and major construction projects from planning through design, permitting, procurement, construction, commissioning, ff&e implementation, and closeout utilizing the Construction Manager/General Contractor (CMGC) delivery method. This position serves as the primary client liaison and provides strategic leadership, technical expertise, and program oversight to ensure successful project delivery in accordance with budget, schedule, quality, and stakeholder objectives. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience managing large-scale facilities, infrastructure, and mission critical projects utilizing varying delivery methods. Experience working within California's public sector procurement and regulatory environment is strongly preferred.

Responsibilities

Project Leadership

Serve as the Owner’s representative and be the primary point of contact for executive stakeholders and project partners.
Lead the project planning, permitting (where required), design, procurement, construction, occupancy and closeout of major capital projects and programs. Includes a deep understanding of program budget development and the ability to collaborate with the ownership stakeholder group to accurately capture all “owner side” budget elements to establish a full and complete owners program budget.
Manage project goals, scope, schedule, budget, quality control, risk management strategies and performance metrics.
Create and manage the contract deliverables matrix, ensuring its successful execution while holding the team accountable for meeting set objectives. Continuously evaluate and verify the scope of services to ensure alignment with Company’s contract terms.
Monitor project progress, address any issues, proactively solve problems that could affect project delivery and provide regular executive-level reporting, presentations, and recommendations
Provide the required executive leadership necessary to lead a large team of subordinate employees, subconsultant team members and owner stakeholders in a high preforming setting to drive execution of the program through accountability, open collaboration and conflict resolution to achieve the project owners desired outcomes.

CMGC Delivery Management

Manage the CMGC procurement and contractor selection process including RFQ/RFP development, evaluations to include scope gap assessments, contractor selection, and contract negotiations.
Lead collaboration between the design team and CMGC contractor during preconstruction.
Facilitate constructability reviews, value engineering workshops, and risk assessments.
Coordinate development and negotiation of the Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP).
Ensure alignment among scope, budget, schedule, and operational requirements.
Promote a partnering environment to minimize disputes and maximize project success.

Design and Preconstruction Oversight

Manage architects, engineers, and specialty consultants through all design phases.
Review and validate operational requirements, space programming, and building systems.
Oversee design quality, constructability, maintainability, and life-cycle value considerations.
Direct cost estimating and budget validation efforts throughout design development.

Construction Administration

Monitor contractor performance related to safety, quality, budget, and schedule.
Review and approve change orders, construction modifications, and project contingencies.
Coordinate inspections, testing, commissioning, and regulatory approvals.
Ensure successful turnover, occupancy, and operational readiness of the facility.
Ensure compliance with applicable California building codes, public contracting requirements, labor compliance regulations, safety standards, and environmental requirements.

Stakeholder Engagement

Coordinate with executive leadership, facilities personnel, operations staff, technology teams, and end users.
Manage communication with public agencies, permitting authorities, utilities, and community stakeholders.
Facilitate project meetings, decision-making sessions, and executive briefings.
Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies to support successful project delivery.

Financial Management

Develop and manage the overall project budget.
Monitor expenditures, forecasts, contingencies, and cash flow.
Identify and mitigate financial and schedule risks throughout project delivery.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, Facilities Management, or related field.
Minimum 20 years of progressively responsible experience managing major facility construction projects.
Demonstrated experience delivering ground-up facilities valued at $100 million or greater.
Minimum 10 years of experience utilizing CMGC, CMAR, Design-Build, or other alternative delivery methods.
Experience managing mission-critical, operations, emergency management, utility, transportation, public sector, or institutional facilities preferred.
Professional Engineer (PE), Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Construction Manager (CCM), Registered Architect (RA), or LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP) certifications preferred.
Experience with CMGC/CMAR delivery methods, building systems and facilities infrastructure, cost estimating and budgeting, GMP development and negotiation, scheduling software (Primavera P6, MS Project), project controls PMIS experience, BIM and digital project delivery tools, contract administration and claims management, commissioning and facility turnover processes
Possesses executive-level communication skills, team leadership and mentoring, negotiation and conflict resolution, strategic planning, risk management, stakeholder engagement
Knowledge of building codes and life safety requirements, public procurement regulations, environmental and sustainability standards, and OSHA and construction safety requirements

Preferred Experience For Facilities CMGC Projects

Candidates should have direct experience managing: airports and transportation facilities, civic and government facilities, data and control centers, laboratory and mission-critical facilities, deferred maintenance and infrastructure renewal programs, and occupied facility renovations requiring phased construction

The salary range for this position is $250,000 - $300,000. The offered salary will be based on the applicants qualifications, education, experience, and work location.

Depending upon your employment status, Hill’s comprehensive benefits may include, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employer Paid Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurances, Business Travel Accident Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Commuter Benefits, Legal Assistance, Identity Theft Protection, Pet Insurance, Auto & Home Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Voluntary Life & Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance. Paid Time Off (PTO), Holidays, 401(K) Retirement Savings Plan, Employee Referral Program, Professional Certification Incentive Program, Hill University Learning and Development, Tuition Reimbursement, EAP, Years of Service Awards Program.

About Us

Hill International, with more than 4,400+ professionals in over 100 offices worldwide, provides program management, project management, construction management, project management oversight, advisory, facilities management, and other consulting services to clients in a variety of market sectors. Engineering News-Record magazine recently ranked Hill as one of the largest program management firms in the world. For more information on Hill, please visit our website at www.hillintl.com .

Hill is exclusively a program, project, and construction management provider, meaning we have one focus as a company: protecting client interests. Free of any potential conflicts, our entire business is geared towards helping clients achieve their desired outcomes. We are dedicated to exceeding expectations throughout the entire construction project lifecycle and adapt to the needs of each assignment to develop tailored approaches and solutions to meet those needs.

Hill is a GISI Consulting Group company, part of the Global Infrastructure Solutions, Inc. (GISI) family of companies. Learn more about GISI Consulting Group at www.gisiconsulting.com .

Hill International is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Role

The Data Analyst turns product, customer, and operational data into reliable analysis that supports product decisions, growth planning, and business performance. The role works across SQL-based warehouses such as Snowflake or BigQuery, dbt models, and BI tools to define metrics, investigate trends, and make complex data accessible to decision-makers.

The analyst partners with product managers, engineers, and business leaders to build trusted reporting and answer high-priority questions with rigor. This role matters because consistent metric definitions, well-designed dashboards, and clear analysis directly influence how teams allocate resources and measure outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Query and analyze large datasets using SQL to identify trends, explain performance changes, and answer recurring and ad hoc business questions
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting in Looker, Tableau, or Mode, ensuring stakeholders have timely access to accurate metrics
Define, document, and monitor core business and product metrics in partnership with product, finance, marketing, and operations teams
Develop reusable data models and transformations in dbt, applying testing and documentation standards to improve reporting reliability
Investigate data quality issues by tracing discrepancies across source systems, warehouse tables, pipelines, and downstream dashboards
Design analyses for experiments, funnels, cohorts, retention, and segmentation; communicate findings with clear recommendations and appropriate caveats
Present concise written and visual analyses to technical and non-technical audiences, translating ambiguous questions into measurable decisions

What We Are Looking For

1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, product analytics, or a related quantitative role
Advanced SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and query optimization on analytical datasets
Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks SQL
Experience building production dashboards and self-service reporting in Looker, Tableau, Mode, Power BI, or an equivalent BI platform
Working knowledge of data modeling and transformation practices, including dbt, dimensional modeling, metric definitions, and data quality testing
Strong analytical communication skills, with the ability to explain methodology, limitations, and recommendations to varied stakeholders
Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, business analytics, or a related quantitative field; equivalent practical experience considered. Bonus: Python or R, experimentation analysis, Amplitude or Mixpanel, Airflow, and experience working with product or marketplace data

What you will do in this role:

Provides case management services for both inpatient and observation patients as assigned. 
Identifies patients who are at risk for adverse outcomes during the transition from one level of care/setting to another. 
Performs a comprehensive assessment of psychosocial, medical and discharge needs of patients/family along with an assessment of resources appropriate and available to the patient/family.

Makes appropriate referrals to third party payer and disease and case management programs for recurring patients and patients with chronic disease states. 
Facilitates patient throughput with an ongoing focus on an effective care transition, quality, and efficiency.

Description

At Amazon, our vision is to become the most customer-centric company on earth. Achieving this goal requires ensuring we continue to work with carriers who are good actors and share this same vision. A key way we accomplish this is through rigorous business intelligence, operational deep dives, and data-driven accountability that enables our teams to deliver flawless execution at scale.

The Relay Central team in Transportation and Technology Services (TTS) is constantly innovating new ways to build scalable solutions that serve millions of customers every day. We hold high standards for our programs and the services we deliver: Our reporting systems are highly accurate, our insights are actionable, and our processes drive measurable outcomes, all while functioning at massive scale and delivering industry-leading operational performance. Our team is passionate about operational excellence and also fun to work with.

You will lead a high-visibility program responsible for business reporting, operational deep dives, and cross-organizational accountability for one of Amazon's most critical transportation networks. In this role, you will own the end-to-end reporting framework that surfaces key insights to Director and VP-level audiences, driving strategic decisions that impact billions of dollars in transportation spend. You will conduct rigorous root cause analyses to identify failure modes, translating complex findings into clear, actionable narratives. You will investigate carrier feedback at scale, synthesizing signals and routing prioritized insights to the appropriate product and engineering teams to drive systemic improvements.

You will be the connective tissue between operations, product, engineering, and senior leadership, bridging technical depth with executive-level storytelling. You will own business goal tracking for the organization, building mechanisms that ensure accountability across multiple teams and organizations for issue resolution and action item closure. You should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources, and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions and proactively present new insights in a concise and effective manner.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, can context-switch between a deep technical investigation and an executive-ready narrative within the same day, and has a bias for action when it comes to closing gaps. You will work directly with partners across product management, engineering, data science, and operations to ensure our reporting infrastructure is robust, our metrics are trustworthy, and our leadership has the information they need to make both high-quality and high-velocity decisions.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end business reporting within the TTS organization for Delivery Accuracy within Middle Mile, delivering high-fidelity operational insights to Director and VP-level audiences on a daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadence
Drive cross-org VP and SVP-level goals related to improving Middle Mile Delivery Accuracy.
Operate within a culture of escalate and debate
Conduct rigorous operational deep dives to identify root causes and failure modes within business logic, data pipelines, SOPs, and technology systems, translating findings into actionable recommendations and driving resolution through cross-functional coordination
Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering to align on reporting priorities and ensure shared visibility into program health and goal attainment
Support in working with other product and program managers globally to identify reporting gaps, systemic issues, and opportunities for process and tooling improvement
Dive deep into data to uncover reporting discrepancies, metric anomalies, and operational trends that unlock new opportunities for improvement
Investigate and synthesize carrier feedback at scale, distilling actionable themes and routing prioritized insights to the appropriate product and engineering teams with clear context and recommended next steps
Own business goal tracking for the organization, building and maintaining mechanisms that ensure transparency into progress, blockers, and risk across multiple teams and senior leadership
Create, maintain, and disseminate program information to stakeholders and leadership across the organization via business reviews, flash reports, and operational readouts, identifying potential bottlenecks, dependencies, or project risks
Drive cross-organizational accountability for issue tracking, escalation management, and action item closure; establishing mechanisms that ensure nothing falls through the cracks
Partner across product and engineering teams to apply new technologies, automation, and tooling to improve reporting infrastructure and operational efficiency

A day in the life

On any given day, you might start by investigating an anomaly that resulted in a customer promise miss, tracing it through reporting logic and tech systems to identify the root cause. By mid-morning, you're synthesizing carrier feedback into a concise brief for the Operations and Product team, then pivoting to prepare a business review narrative for senior leadership (Director/VP). Afternoons could involve driving accountability in a cross-functional stand-up with operations, program management, and product managers, tracking action items to closure, or building the weekly operational readout that keeps our organization aligned. Your internal stakeholders span Product, Engineering, Program Management, and Operations Supply Chain leadership. Your customers are the senior leaders who depend on accurate, timely insights to make high-quality decisions, and the product, program, and operations teams who rely on your investigations to prioritize the right problems.

About The Team

The Technology Transportation Services (TTS) organization builds software systems that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both time and cost of getting the packages delivered. Our services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers, owner operators and drivers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers. That said, this remains a fast growing business and our technical journey has only started. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, unique delivery models for products ranging from Amazon Fresh groceries, ultra-fast Prime Now deliveries of big-screen TV’s, increasingly complex transportation network, and growing number of shipments worldwide, we see a massive opportunity to fundamentally change the way people get the stuff they need, and make a big impact by cutting billions of dollars of transportation costs from the ecosystem. Our mission is to build the most efficient and optimal transportation solution on the planet, using our science and technology muscle as our biggest advantage.

About The Role

The Business Data Analyst turns operational and product data into clear analysis that supports decisions across growth, finance, customer operations, and product teams. The role works across SQL-based data warehouses, BI tools, and curated reporting models to define metrics, investigate performance changes, and deliver trusted insights.

The analyst will partner with stakeholders to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analysis and repeatable reporting. Success means improving data visibility, identifying meaningful trends, and building dashboards and datasets that teams can use without manual intervention.

Analyze product, customer, revenue, and operational data using SQL to identify trends, anomalies, and drivers of business performance

Translate stakeholder questions into analytical requirements, measurable KPIs, and scoped deliverables with clear timelines
Partner with analytics engineers to improve dbt models, data transformations, and the reliability of downstream reporting
Validate datasets and reporting outputs through reconciliation checks, anomaly detection, and documented quality-control processes
Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders using concise narratives, visualizations, and supporting analysis
Automate recurring analysis and reporting workflows with Python, spreadsheet scripting, or scheduled warehouse queries

2–4 years of experience in business analysis, data analysis, product analytics, operations analytics, or a related quantitative role
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and query-performance fundamentals
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks SQL
Experience building production dashboards and self-service reporting in Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or a comparable BI platform
Working knowledge of data modeling concepts, dimensional schemas, metric definitions, and transformation frameworks such as dbt
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings, assumptions, and limitations to business and technical audiences
